desc: Read input N, K, and the three sequences A, B, C.
Sort A, B, C in descending order.
Initialize a max-heap with the triple (0,0,0) and compute its value, and a visited set with its encoded index.

Loop K times: pop the maximum value, store it as the current answer, then push valid unvisited neighbors (i+1,j,k), (i,j+1,k), (i,j,k+1) with their computed values, avoiding duplicates via visited set.
After the loop, print the stored answer from the K-th pop.
Test the implementation on the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
